boundary: toroidal; assert no cells touch boundary in any measured frame
interpretation: A moving recurrent object can yield many image-unique observations without new intrinsic shape organization. Translation and velocity remain functionally important for navigation and collisions. Neither descriptor is universally correct.
limits: Not a test of CLIP, ASAL, AURORA or Lenia.
Known hand-selected patterns; no search algorithm comparison or inferential statistics.
No evidence of agent-team superiority, indefinite novelty, evolution or cognition.
Translation normalization is appropriate only when absolute location is irrelevant to the question.
